note: Development attempts of the persistent-tab placeholder grid measurement (#989) in order. Only the retained files are kept; none produced a grade.

attempts.reason: A complete run (14/14), published first. Review then found that the grid oracle read a painted cell only inside its sampled rectangle, so a tile could have passed by painting just that rectangle (the retained pixels also satisfy the stricter reading); the fix edits a measured file (the oracle: the part of each tile that every placement of the square covers must be painted too), so the run is superseded by a fresh one.
